task.instruction: Search an Xbox Wireless controller with green color and rated above 4 stars.

final_answer:
I searched Amazon for "xbox wireless controller green" and applied the "4 Stars & Up" filter. The page now shows a "Remove 4 Stars & Up filter" link, which confirms the filter is active. The results are in Malaysian ringgit (MYR) because the page ships to Malaysia.

Green Xbox Wireless controllers in the results, all rated above 4 stars:
- XBOX Wireless Gaming Controller | Velocity Green: 4.6 out of 5 stars (1,013 ratings).
- Xbox Wireless Controller – Velocity Green, for Series X|S, One, and Windows Devices: 4.4 out of 5 stars (177 ratings), MYR 227.16.
- Xbox Wireless Controller – Velocity Green, for Series X|S, One, and Windows Devices (a second listing): 4.2 out of 5 stars (179 ratings), MYR 227.32.

The filtered results also include a sponsored Anvex wireless controller (5.0 stars, but only 1 rating). They also include an Electric Volt Xbox controller (4.6 stars), which is not green.

judge.rationale: Final page shows Amazon results for “xbox wireless controller green” with 4 Stars & Up filter and green Xbox controllers rated 4.6, 4.4, and 4.2.

args.description: 4 Stars & Up filter selected in refinements sidebar
